cell_line.evidence: Human embryonic kidney 293T (HEK293T) cells were cultured in Dulbecco’s modified Eagle’s medium (DMEM, Corning) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS, Gibco), 1% l-glutamine (200 mM, Gibco), and 1% penicillin/streptomycin (10,000 U; 10,000 μg/mL, Gibco).
TetON inducible cystic fibrosis bronchial epithelial cells (CFBE) were generously gifted by Dr. Guido Veit and Dr. Gergely Lukacs, McGill University.
